summary.text: Nicholeen Peck is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 28 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator.

paragraphs.text: Nicholeen Peck was born in Salt Lake City, Utah, and earned a high school diploma from Hillcrest High School.
According to Ballotpedia, her career experience includes working as an educator, author, in family policy, and in behavioral science.
She succeeded Timothy Adrian Jimenez as the representative for District 28.
